What is the ratio between the expenditure on taxes in the year 2014 to the total expenditure on transport for all the years respectively?
solution:
**Given:**

Expenditure on Taxes in 2014 = 2 million $

Total Expenditure on Transport for all years = Transport in 2012 + Transport in 2013 + Transport in 2014 + Transport in 2015

**Formula used:**

Ratio = Expenditure on Taxes in 2014 ÷ Total Expenditure on Transport for all years

**Calculation:**

Total Expenditure on Transport = 48 (2012) + 60 (2013) + 71 (2014) + 82 (2015)

⇒ Total Transport Expenditure = 48 + 60 + 71 + 82 = 261 million $

Ratio = 2 ÷ 261

⇒ Ratio = 1:130.5

**∴ The ratio between the expenditure on taxes in 2014 to the total expenditure on transport for all the years is approximately 1:130.5.**
